note: 생활 장면표(계획 Task 4, 2026-11-19) — 그 도시 사람들이 실제로 보내는 하루의 장면을 세 세계로 옮긴다(설계 3-1절). 장면은 그 도시에 실제로 있는 생활 모습만, 근거 src(위키백과). 장면 한 줄: key · ko · src · base(받침 · 장소 종류 · 자세 추천을 빌리는 일상컷 트리 장소 — data/casual-tree*.json) · indoor(날씨 줄 없음) · times · seasons(되는 시간대 · 계절 — 없으면 다) · outfits(이 장면에서 계획기가 고르는 의상 계열) · en(세계를 타지 않은 장면 이름 — 트리 장소 글, 지시문에는 안 나온다) · worlds.<세계>.en(같은 일상이 그 세계의 시대로 옮겨진 모습 — 일상컷 Place 줄) · props(소품 열쇠 — data/world-props.json, Around her 줄). 조립기(lib/prompt-city.js lifeTree)가 장면마다 트리 장소 <도시>_<장면> 을 만든다(받침은 base 것, 땅 = 도시). times 는 모든 도시가 같이, seasons · weather 는 도시마다(그 도시에 맞는 것만, 근거). 판타지 · 스팀펑크 글에는 그 세계 banned_en(data/city-design.json) 낱말이 없다(tests/prompt-city.cjs).

times.en: dawn — the first pale light before the city wakes, the last lamps still lit and the streets quiet
the morning rush hour — low clean sunlight and the city's crowd hurrying to work
the evening rush after work — the warm low sun sinking into dusk and lamps coming on along the street
evening turning to night — the scene lit by its own lamps and windows under a dark sky
past midnight — the last lamps still burning and the streets nearly empty

seoul.en: spring — cherry blossoms in bloom and petals drifting on the air
the jangma rainy season of early summer — heavy, humid air under low grey skies
high summer — hot, humid air and strong sunlight
autumn — cool, clear, dry air and turning leaves
winter — cold, dry, frosty air, breath showing in the cold

tokyo.en: spring — cherry blossoms in full bloom and petals drifting on the air
the tsuyu rainy season of early summer — humid air and soft, steady rain under low grey skies
high summer — hot, humid air and strong sunlight
autumn — clear, mild air and ginkgo trees turning bright golden yellow
winter — cool, dry, clear air under bright pale skies

newyork.en: spring — mild air, fresh green leaves and flowering trees in the parks
high summer — hot, humid air and strong sunlight
autumn — crisp, clear air and park trees turning red, orange and gold
winter — cold air, bare trees and old snow along the curbs

rome.en: spring — mild air, fresh green leaves and flowers spilling from the balconies
high summer — hot, dry air under a fierce, cloudless sun
autumn — mild golden days between the year's heaviest rains
winter — mild, cool days and damp air, bare trees beside the evergreen pines

paris.en: spring — mild days and cool nights, fresh green leaves on the avenue trees and flowers in the gardens
summer — warm, sunny days, now and then a spell of intense heat
autumn — mild, changeable days and cool nights, the avenue trees turning gold
winter — cold, grey days just above freezing, bare trees and a light frost in the morning

london.en: spring — mild days and fresh green leaves in the parks and garden squares
summer — warm, sometimes hot days and everyone out on the grass in the parks
autumn — cooler, changeable days and the park trees turning gold
winter — cool, grey days under frequent cloud and bare trees in the garden squares

beijing.en: spring — dry, quickly warming days, fresh green leaves on the willows and now and then a dusty wind from the far deserts
summer — hot, humid monsoon days, heavy air and sudden rain
autumn — a short, dry and clear season, crisp blue skies and the trees turning gold
winter — brief but cold, dry days under clear pale skies, the lakes frozen and the willows bare

istanbul.en: spring — mild days slowly warming after a chilly March, fresh green leaves on the hillsides along the strait
summer — warm to hot, mostly sunny and fairly dry days, a breeze off the water
autumn — mild, still-warm days slowly turning cooler, cloudier and wetter
winter — cool, cloudy and frequently rainy days, now and then snow

cairo.en: spring — warm, quickly heating days under a pale sky, and now and then a hot, dusty wind blowing in from the desert
summer — long, hot and dry days of strong sun and hard shadows, the evenings warm and close by the river
autumn — still-warm, sunny days slowly turning milder, the evenings by the river growing pleasant
winter — mild, mostly sunny days and cool nights, now and then a brief shower

rio.en: summer — December to March, hot, humid and stormy days, the heat broken by long spells of heavy rain
carnival days — the hot late-summer days before Lent, when the whole city fills with drums, brass bands, dancing crowds and costumes
autumn — still-warm days after the summer rains, the air growing a little less heavy
winter — June to August, warm, sunny and drier days, the mornings cooled by sea breezes and passing cold fronts
spring — warm days slowly growing hotter and more humid toward summer

busan.en: spring — mild sea air and cherry blossoms along the river
early summer — warm days kept cooler than inland by the sea breeze
high summer, the beach season — hot, humid air and crowded beaches
late summer, the typhoon season — hot, humid and rainy, with storms sweeping in from the sea
autumn, the festival season — clear skies and pleasant, comfortable air
winter — cool, dry and windy, milder than the rest of the country

bangkok.en: the hot season — March to mid-May, fierce sun and heavy, sticky heat, April the hottest month of the year
Songkran days — the Thai New Year in mid-April, at the height of the heat, when the whole city takes to the streets to splash each other with water
the rainy season — mid-May to October, the southwest monsoon bringing heavy afternoon downpours, September the wettest month
the cool season — November to February, the dry northeast monsoon bringing clearer skies, a fresher breeze and the mildest mornings of the year, the days still warm

barcelona.en: spring — March to late May, mild and changeable days, sometimes a sea fog rolling in off the still-cool water
summer — late May to late September, warm to hot days, long hours of sunshine and a sea breeze along the shore
autumn — October to December, the rainiest season, mild days broken by long spells of rain
winter — mild, short days with cool mornings, now and then a cold north wind sweeping down to the sea

sydney.en: summer — December to February, warm to hot days by the water, the beaches crowded and the evenings long and bright
autumn — March to May, settled, mild days turning cooler and crisper from mid-April
winter — June to August, mild, cool and mostly sunny days with chilly mornings by the sea
spring — September to November, warming days with sudden swings of weather and the jacaranda trees blooming violet

mexicocity.en: the cool dry season — November to February, crisp sunny days and chilly mornings under a clear, dry highland sky
the warm dry spring — March to May, bright warm days before the rains, the air still dry
jacaranda time in March — the city's jacaranda trees in full violet bloom, purple blossoms carpeting the pavements
the rainy summer — May to October, mild green days and heavy rains, the wettest in July

daejeon.en: spring — mild days and cherry blossoms in bloom along the lakeside roads
the monsoon season of high summer — the heaviest rain of the year, warm and wet
high summer — hot and humid, a little milder than the other big cities
autumn — clear skies with the least cloud of the year and the first frost early in the season
winter — cold and dry, with a north-west wind

venice.en: spring — mild, changeable days, soft light on the lagoon and the last high tides of the season
summer — warm, humid days, July averaging about 24 °C, long bright evenings on the water
autumn — cooling, damp days, the season of high tides pushing in from the Adriatic
winter — cool, damp days, January averaging about 4 °C, sometimes snow between late November and early March

prague.en: spring — mild, freshening days, fruit trees blossoming on the hillside parks and late spring bringing the first heavy showers
summer — plenty of sunshine and warm days around twenty-five degrees, cool nights and sudden thundershowers
autumn — cooling days, the park trees turning gold and red, and from mid-October cold foggy mornings over the river
winter — cold, short days around freezing with very little sunshine, snow often lying on the roofs from mid-November to late March

dubai.en: the cool months — warm, sunny days around twenty-five degrees, mild evenings and now and then a passing shower, the best time of year to be outdoors
the warm months of late spring and early autumn — hot, bright days and warm, humid evenings by the sea
high summer — fierce, humid heat under a white-hot sun, life moving indoors by day and out to the waterfront at night

hongkong.en: spring — March and April, pleasant days broken by spells of heavy humidity, with fog and drizzle rolling over the hills
summer — May to August, long, hot and humid, with showers and thunderstorms; most of the year's rain falls between May and September
typhoon season — July to September, when tropical cyclones most often pass close and storm signals go up over the harbour
Mid-Autumn days — the fifteenth night of the eighth lunar month, in September or early October, when the parks fill with lanterns and mooncakes are shared under the full moon
late autumn — November and December, pleasant breezes, plenty of sunshine and comfortable temperatures
winter — January and February, cooler and cloudier, with cold fronts followed by dry northerly winds

sanfrancisco.en: winter — the cool rainy season from November, showers sweeping in off the Pacific and the air mild and damp
spring — the last showers of the rainy season giving way to the dry months, mild days and the first fog creeping back
summer — June to August, the coolest summer of any big American city, cool winds and thick fog pouring in through the Golden Gate
autumn — September and October, the warmest weeks of the year, the fog thinning and the bay shining in clear sunlight

vienna.en: spring — changeable days of sun and passing cloud, the parks greening and the last frosts of April fading
summer — warm to hot, showery days with highs around twenty-seven to thirty-two degrees and long light evenings by the water
autumn — cool, clear days, the park trees turning gold and the first frosts arriving in November
winter — fairly cold and relatively dry, days around freezing, frost on the gardens and the ball season in full swing

edinburgh.en: spring — cool, fresh days and brisk winds off the hills, cold sea fog sometimes rolling in from the firth
summer — mild days rarely warmer than the low twenties, the whole city crowded and buzzing for its August festivals
autumn — cooler, blustery days, the park trees turning gold and the first Atlantic gales sweeping in
winter — cold, grey days that seldom drop below freezing, frost on the stone and the great New Year street party at the year's end

kyoto.en: spring — cherry trees in full bloom along the canals and on the hills, petals drifting onto the water
the rainy season — from mid-June to the end of July, soft steady rain under low grey skies over the basin
high summer in the basin — hot and humid, the latter half of the season hot and sunny after the rains
autumn — the maple-covered slopes of the river gorges turning red and gold
winter — relatively cold for the region, trapped in the mountain-ringed basin, with occasional snowfall

capetown.en: summer — December to March, warm, dry and sunny, the strong south-east wind blowing for days and the tablecloth of cloud lying on the mountain
autumn — April and May, the south-easter season over, mild sunny days and the odd thunderstorm before the winter fronts arrive
winter — June to September, mild and wet, cold fronts sweeping in from the Atlantic with rain and strong north-westerly winds, frost and snow sometimes on the mountain tops
spring — September to November, the south-easter returning, the days warming and whales passing close along the coast

moscow.en: winter — long and cold from mid-November to late March, days around minus ten degrees, snow lying thirty to forty centimetres deep and short, dim days with little sun
spring — the most changeable season, the snow melting away in late March and April, quick swings between thaw and frost, then fresh green leaves in May
summer — warm days around twenty to twenty-five degrees with long light evenings, the sunniest time of year, thunderstorms common early in the season
autumn — a warm, dry September with a golden spell of returning summer heat, then from mid-October wet, stormy grey days, frosty nights and the first flurries of snow

buenosaires.en: summer — December to February, hot and humid, with frequent thunderstorms and short heat waves
autumn — March to May, mild and changeable, warm afternoons turning to cool nights and fog rising off the river
winter — June to August, cool, damp and often grey, the air heavy with humidity and frost rare
spring — September to November, mild days and cool nights, the jacaranda trees along the streets in violet bloom

havana.en: the cool dry months — November to February, sunny and mild at around 22°C, the lightest rain of the year and now and then a winter cold front off the sea
the warm end of the dry season — March and April, sunny and dry, the trade wind blowing and the days growing hotter before the rains
the rainy summer — May to August, hot and humid at around 28°C, heavy rain setting in from June
the stormy autumn — September and October, still hot and humid, the year's heaviest rain in October and tropical storms at their most common

marrakech.en: spring — the days warming and the orchards green, snow still lying on the high peaks of the mountains to the south
summer — long, hot and dry, white sun on the red walls and the air shimmering over the plain
autumn — the long summer heat easing into warm golden days before the wetter, cooler half of the year
winter — brief, mild to cool and the wettest time of year, the mountains to the south covered in snow and ice

reykjavik.en: summer — the light nights of late May to late July when the sun barely sets, cool fresh air around ten to fifteen degrees
autumn — the nights growing dark again, the first aurora returning to the sky and the sea winds rising
winter — short days of a few hours of low light, snow, cold sea gales and steam rising thick from the warm pools

taipei.en: spring — cherry blossoms on the volcanic hills north of the city and mild, hazy days in the basin
the plum-rain season — from May into June, long spells of soft, warm rain under low grey skies
the long summer — very hot and humid, with sudden heavy rainstorms and typhoons
the short winter — generally mild but often foggy, with the occasional cold front and never any snow
Lunar New Year into the Lantern Festival on the fifteenth day — the old street's new-year market and paper sky lanterns rising into the night

lisbon.en: spring — mild, brightening days as the winter rains thin out, sunshine returning to the tiled facades and the river
summer — the dry season, warm to hot cloudless days with highs around twenty-five to thirty-two degrees in August and long golden evenings over the river
autumn — still warm early on, then the first rains returning and the river light turning soft and silver
winter — mild and rainy, cool days around fourteen to nineteen degrees, wet cobbles shining between bright spells

berlin.en: spring — chilly to mild days, the linden trees and the big parks leafing out green
summer — warm and sometimes humid, highs around twenty-two to twenty-five degrees and long light evenings by the lakes and the river
autumn — chilly to mild days, the park trees turning gold and the evenings drawing in early
winter — cold, days around three degrees and nights just below freezing, frost common and snow falling from December through March

gyeongju.en: spring — cherry trees in full bloom around the wide lake and along the old roads, petals drifting over the grass mounds in April
the monsoon season — from late June to early August, long warm rains under low grey skies over the basin
high summer — hot and humid, the grass mounds deep green and the palace pond still under a hazy white sky
autumn — clear, mild days, the low hills turning red and gold, and the October festival of the ancient capital with folk games, music and dance
winter — cool rather than bitter, milder than the inland thanks to the nearby coast, bare trees over the brown winter mounds

lasvegas.en: spring — warm, dry days under a clear desert sky and cool evenings before the long heat
summer — long and extremely hot, afternoon highs around forty degrees, very dry air and blazing light off the stone
autumn — the heat easing into warm, dry, golden days and mild desert nights
winter — short and mild, cool sunny days with snow lying on the mountains around the valley

cyberpunk.en: a kiosk on the beach promenade two centuries on with a softly glowing counter — bowls of thick, icy dark-purple açaí topped with sliced banana and granola, the wave promenade traced in light underfoot and the sea glittering beyond

cyberpunk.en: the long tiled stairway between two old quarters two centuries on, kept as it stands — every step and wall still set with glazed tiles of every colour, green, yellow and blue above all, and little pieces of mirror, softly lit from beneath each step

cyberpunk.en: the long seaside road two centuries on, kept free for people on Sundays — bikes, light-wheeled skates and strollers flowing along the ocean, the wave promenade traced in light beside them and twin mountain peaks at the far end of the beach

scenes.ko: 가리발디 광장의 밤 — 마리아치 악단이 노래를 판다
scenes.en: an evening at Plaza Garibaldi, the city's home of mariachi music, where bands of violins, trumpets and guitars in embroidered charro suits play songs for passers-by

fantasy.en: a lantern-lit square of the capital at night — bands of violinists, guitarists and trumpeters in short heavily embroidered jackets, ruffled shirts and wide-brimmed hats playing songs for whoever asks, couples listening and lamps glowing in the arcades

steampunk.en: a gaslit square at night — mariachi bands in short heavily embroidered jackets, ruffled shirts, fitted trousers and wide-brimmed hats playing violins, guitars and brass trumpets for whoever asks under strings of paper banners

cyberpunk.en: the mariachi square two centuries on at night — bands in heavily embroidered short jackets and wide-brimmed hats playing violins, guitars and trumpets for whoever asks, soft light rippling over the old arcades and couples listening

scenes.ko: 동네 요일장 티앙기스 — 차일 아래 이어지는 노점들
scenes.en: a weekly tianguis market closing off a neighbourhood street, stalls under bright awnings selling fruit, food and everything else

fantasy.en: a market day on a street of the capital — long rows of stalls under bright canvas awnings, heaps of fruit, chilies and flowers, woven baskets and clay pots, vendors calling out their wares

steampunk.en: a weekly market closing off a street — rows of stalls under striped canvas awnings, heaps of fruit, chilies and flowers, tin pots and woven baskets, vendors calling out over the crowd

cyberpunk.en: a weekly street market two centuries on — rows of stalls under bright smart-fabric awnings, heaps of real fruit, chilies and flowers, vendors calling out and little delivery drones hovering overhead

scenes.ko: 동네 빵집 — 조개 무늬 단빵 콘차 고르기
scenes.en: choosing sweet breads at a neighbourhood panadería, shelves of conchas with their shell-patterned sugar tops

fantasy.en: a warm bakery of the capital — wooden shelves heaped with round sweet buns crowned with crackly sugar tops scored like seashells, golden twists and little loaves, the smell of fresh bread in the air

steampunk.en: a neighbourhood bakery with glass-fronted cabinets — rows of round sweet buns with crackly sugar tops scored like seashells, golden twists and little loaves, a brass till and a warm oven glowing at the back

cyberpunk.en: a neighbourhood bakery two centuries on — real round sweet buns with crackly sugar tops scored like seashells on softly lit shelves, golden twists and little loaves and a warm oven glowing at the back

scenes.ko: 주말 코요아칸 광장 — 거리 공연과 에스키테스 · 엘로테
scenes.en: a weekend afternoon in the old plazas of Coyoacán, street performers and musicians, vendors selling esquites and corn on the cob with lime, chili and grated cheese

fantasy.en: a cobbled old plaza of the capital on a holiday afternoon — jugglers, musicians and storytellers entertaining the crowd, vendors scooping warm corn into cups with lime, chili and grated cheese

steampunk.en: a cobbled old plaza on a weekend afternoon — street performers and a little band entertaining the crowd, vendors with brass braziers selling corn on the cob and cups of warm corn with lime, chili and grated cheese

cyberpunk.en: a cobbled old plaza kept two centuries on — street performers and musicians, vendors selling cups of warm corn with lime, chili and grated cheese and banners of cut light drifting overhead

scenes.ko: 풀케리아 — 초록빛 유리잔의 풀케와 과일 큐라도
scenes.en: an evening at a pulquería, the old working-class bar of milky pulque served in greenish hand-blown glasses, plain or cured with fruit

fantasy.en: an old tavern of the capital in the evening — painted walls, long wooden tables, great barrels of milky agave drink and greenish hand-blown glasses of it, some swirled pink and gold with fruit

steampunk.en: an old pulque bar in the gaslit evening — painted walls, a long wooden counter with barrels behind it, greenish hand-blown glasses of milky pulque, some cured pink and gold with fruit, and regulars in waistcoats

cyberpunk.en: an old pulque bar kept two centuries on — painted walls, real barrels behind a softly lit counter, greenish hand-blown glasses of milky pulque, some cured pink and gold with fruit

scenes.ko: 유성온천 족욕장 — 따뜻한 온천물 얕은 못에 발 담그기
scenes.en: the free open-air foot bath of Yuseong Hot Spring, people sitting on its stone edges with their feet in the shallow warm water

fantasy.en: the open-air warm-spring foot bath of the old hot-spring town of the capital — a long shallow pool of warm mineral water edged with smooth stones and benches, a little wooden pavilion roofing one end, white blossom trees along the street and soft steam drifting up

steampunk.en: the open-air foot bath of the hot-spring town — a long shallow pool of warm mineral water edged with stone benches, a little wooden water-wheel turning, folded towels on a brass rack and gas lamps along a street of white blossom trees

cyberpunk.en: the open-air foot bath of the hot-spring district two centuries on — a long shallow pool of warm mineral water in smooth pale stone, softly glowing benches and steam drifting through layers of light along a street of white blossom trees

scenes.ko: 엑스포다리 · 한빛탑 주말 밤 불빛 산책
scenes.en: a weekend night walk across the lit Expo Bridge over the Gapcheon, the lit Hanbit Tower glowing beyond

fantasy.en: a graceful arched bridge over the river of the capital at night, its slender arches and cables glowing with soft enchanted light mirrored in the dark water, and a tall white stone tower lit up across the river

steampunk.en: a graceful iron bridge over the river at night, its arches and cables traced with rows of gas lamps mirrored in the dark water, and across the river a tall white stone tower lit up by limelight

cyberpunk.en: the lit bridge over the river two centuries on, its arches and cables rippling with shifting light mirrored in the black water, and a tall white tower glowing across the river

scenes.ko: 갑천 강변 자전거길 — 공공 자전거로 달리기
scenes.en: a ride along the riverside cycle path of the Gapcheon on a public rental bicycle

fantasy.en: the willow-lined riverside path along the clear river through the capital — people riding light wooden bicycles past reed beds and stepping-stones, green hills beyond

steampunk.en: the riverside cycle path along the willow-lined river — riders on tall brass-trimmed bicycles past iron footbridges and gas lamps, a little paddle-boat on the water

cyberpunk.en: the riverside cycle path two centuries on — a smooth lane lit from beneath along the willow-lined river, riders on slim shared bicycles with glowing rims and bridges of light overhead

scenes.ko: 두부두루치기 — 칼칼한 양념에 졸인 두부 한 판
scenes.en: a small local restaurant serving dubu-duruchigi, slices of tofu simmered down with spring onions in a spicy red sauce, a Chungcheong dish said to come from Daejeon

fantasy.en: a warm low-beamed eating house of the capital — worn wooden tables and a shallow iron pan of tofu slices simmered down in a glossy spicy red sauce with spring onions, little side dishes around it

steampunk.en: a bustling little eating house on a gaslit street — marble-topped tables, a copper pan of tofu slices simmered down in a glossy spicy red sauce with spring onions and little enamel side dishes

cyberpunk.en: a late-night eatery two centuries on — a warm-lit counter of smart glass, a heat-keeping pan of tofu slices simmered down in a glossy spicy red sauce with spring onions and little side dishes

scenes.ko: 대전역 승강장 가락국수 — 열차를 기다리며 한 그릇
scenes.en: a quick bowl of thick wheat noodles at the noodle counter on the platform of Daejeon Station, eaten while the train waits

fantasy.en: a busy platform of the great waystation of the capital — a little noodle counter steaming under the eaves, travellers slurping bowls of thick wheat noodles in hot broth while the rune-lit carriages wait

steampunk.en: the gaslit platform of the great railway junction — a little noodle counter steaming under the glass roof, travellers slurping bowls of thick wheat noodles in hot broth while the steam locomotive is turned around

cyberpunk.en: a high platform of the great maglev junction two centuries on — a compact noodle counter glowing warm, travellers slurping bowls of thick wheat noodles in hot broth while a sleek train waits

scenes.ko: 대전 중앙시장 — 대전역 앞 큰 재래시장의 거리들
scenes.en: Jungang Market by Daejeon Station, once the largest traditional market of central Korea, with its themed streets of food, fish, tableware and accessories

fantasy.en: the great old market by the waystation of the capital — lanes of stalls under canvas awnings, rows of food, fish, tableware and trinkets, and vendors calling out

steampunk.en: the great covered market beside the railway station — lanes of stalls under an iron-and-glass roof, rows of food, fish, enamel tableware and trinkets, gas lamps and vendors calling out

cyberpunk.en: the old market by the junction two centuries on — lanes of stalls under a curved glass canopy, price tags glowing in abstract shapes over rows of food, tableware and trinkets

scenes.ko: 으능정이 거리 스카이로드 — 머리 위 거대한 빛 그림 지붕 아래 밤 나들이
scenes.en: an evening on the old-town shopping street of Eunhaeng-dong under the Skyroad, a long arcade roof of giant moving light-pictures above the shoppers

fantasy.en: a busy shopping street of the old town of the capital at night — a vast arched canopy high overhead alive with moving enchanted pictures of light, shoppers and street dancers below

steampunk.en: a busy shopping street at night under a long iron-and-glass arcade roof where a great magic-lantern show plays moving pictures of light overhead, shoppers strolling below under gas lamps

cyberpunk.en: a busy shopping street two centuries on under a vast arched canopy of moving light-pictures, shoppers and street dancers below in a wash of shifting colour

scenes.ko: 한밭수목원 산책 — 한국에서 가장 큰 도심 인공 수목원
scenes.en: a stroll in the Hanbat Arboretum, the largest man-made urban arboretum in Korea, laid out over the old Expo parking grounds

fantasy.en: a vast garden of the capital with themed groves of trees and wildflowers, a wetland boardwalk and a glass house of tropical plants, people strolling under the trees

steampunk.en: a vast arboretum of themed groves, a wetland boardwalk and a great glass-and-iron palm house of tropical plants, people strolling under the trees

cyberpunk.en: a vast arboretum two centuries on — themed groves of real trees, a wetland boardwalk lit from beneath and a soaring glass dome of tropical plants

scenes.ko: 계족산 황톳길 — 맨발로 걷는 붉은 흙길
scenes.en: walking barefoot along the long red-clay trail through the woods of Gyejoksan

fantasy.en: a soft red-clay path winding through the pine woods of the mountain above the capital — people walking it barefoot with their shoes in hand, sunlight falling through the pines

steampunk.en: a soft red-clay path winding through the pine woods above the city — walkers barefoot with their boots tied over their shoulders, a little brass water fountain for rinsing feet beside the path

cyberpunk.en: a soft red-clay path through the pine woods above the megacity two centuries on — walkers barefoot on the warm clay, small glowing markers along the trail and a rinsing fountain of clear light

scenes.ko: 대전시민천문대 — 한국 첫 시민 천문대에서 별 보기
scenes.en: a night of stargazing at the Daejeon Citizen's Observatory, the first citizen observatory in Korea, through its refracting telescope

fantasy.en: a hilltop star-watching hall above the capital at night — a domed roof opened to the sky, a long star-glass of brass and crystal on a carved stand and the lights of the plain far below

steampunk.en: a hilltop observatory above the city at night — the brass dome slid open to the stars, a long brass refracting telescope on its iron mount and gas lamps turned low

cyberpunk.en: a hilltop observatory two centuries on — a clear dome opening to the night sky, a slim telescope tracing the stars with a soft ring of light and the glowing city far below

scenes.ko: 대청호 벚꽃길 — 호숫가를 따라 길게 이어진 봄 벚꽃
scenes.en: a spring walk on the long cherry-blossom road that winds around Daecheong Lake

fantasy.en: a lakeside road of cherry trees in full pale pink bloom winding along a wide still lake, petals drifting onto the water and small pine-covered islands offshore

steampunk.en: a lakeside road of cherry trees in full pale pink bloom along a wide still lake, a paddle-steamer at a little wooden landing and petals drifting onto the water

cyberpunk.en: a lakeside road of real cherry trees in full pale pink bloom two centuries on, a softly glowing walking lane beside it and petals drifting over the clear lake

scenes.ko: 대덕 연구 단지 과학 대학 캠퍼스 잔디밭의 점심
scenes.en: a lunch break on the lawn of the science university campus in the research district

fantasy.en: the green lawn of the great academy of sages in the capital — scholars' halls of pale granite around it, students in robes reading under old trees

steampunk.en: the lawn of the university of inventors — red-brick halls with brass-domed laboratories around it, students in waistcoats reading under old trees and a little steam-driven model whirring on the grass

cyberpunk.en: the lawn of the science university two centuries on — white curved research halls around it, students reading under real old trees beside softly glowing benches

scenes.ko: 원도심 빵집 순례 — 이름난 오래된 빵집 앞 줄과 갓 튀긴 소보로빵
scenes.en: a bakery pilgrimage in Daejeon's old downtown — a long, cheerful queue outside a beloved old bakery, warm paper bags of freshly fried crumble-topped soboro buns and wooden shelves stacked with breads, no sign or name visible

fantasy.en: a cobbled lane of the capital's old quarter where a famous old bakers' guildhall sends out the smell of fresh bread — a long, cheerful queue at its carved wooden door, baskets of golden crumble-topped buns cooling on the sill, no sign or lettering

steampunk.en: a gaslit arcade of the railway town's old quarter where a beloved steam-oven bakery puffs warm white steam — a long, cheerful queue under its glass awning, brass racks of golden crumble-topped buns behind the window, no sign or lettering

cyberpunk.en: a preserved old-downtown street two centuries on where a legendary bakery still bakes by hand — a long, cheerful queue under warm glowing awnings, glass shelves of golden crumble-topped buns lit like jewels, no sign or lettering

scenes.ko: 트라게토 — 두 사공이 젓는 곤돌라 나룻배로 큰 운하 건너기
scenes.en: crossing the Grand Canal by traghetto, the plain gondola ferry rowed by two oarsmen at points where there is no bridge

fantasy.en: crossing the great canal on a plain black ferry-gondola rowed by two oarsmen, passengers crowded aboard and lace-arched palaces sliding past on either bank

steampunk.en: crossing the great canal on a plain black ferry-gondola rowed by two oarsmen, gaslit palaces on either bank and a brass steam water-bus puffing clean white steam in the distance

cyberpunk.en: the old two-oared ferry-gondola still crossing the great canal two centuries on, passengers crowded aboard as ever, silent glowing water-taxis passing behind

scenes.ko: 바포레토 — 공공 수상 버스로 큰 운하 출퇴근
scenes.en: riding the vaporetto, the city's public waterbus, along the Grand Canal between the palaces

fantasy.en: on the rail of a broad public water-barge under a striped canopy, gliding down the great canal under oar and sail past palaces of pink and ivory stone

steampunk.en: on the rail of a little brass-funnelled steam water-bus puffing clean white steam down the great canal, gas lamps lit along the quays

cyberpunk.en: on the rail of a silent electric water-bus gliding down the great canal on route lines of soft light, the old palaces lit on both banks

scenes.ko: 바카로 — 선 채로 치케티와 옴브라 · 스프리츠
scenes.en: standing at the counter of a bacaro, a simple Venetian wine bar, with cicchetti (small bites on bread) and a small glass of white wine or a spritz

fantasy.en: a low-beamed wine tavern by a little canal, the counter heaped with little bites on bread, casks along the wall and lantern-light on the water outside the open door

steampunk.en: a snug wine bar by a little canal, its marble counter heaped with little bites on bread under warm gaslight, barrels along the wall and a brass tap gleaming

cyberpunk.en: a tiny old wine bar by a little canal kept as it was, its counter heaped with little bites on bread on softly glowing trays and drinkers spilling out onto the quay

scenes.ko: 리알토 시장 — 리알토 다리 옆 아침 생선 · 채소 시장
scenes.en: morning shopping at the Rialto markets beside the Rialto Bridge — fish, fruit and vegetables under the old arcades by the Grand Canal

fantasy.en: the morning market under stone arcades beside the great bridge of shops — fish glittering on beds of ice and seaweed, heaps of artichokes, peaches and lemons, boats unloading crates at the water-stairs

steampunk.en: the morning market under stone arcades beside the great bridge of shops — fish glittering on beds of ice, heaps of artichokes and lemons, brass scales and painted price boards with no readable letters

cyberpunk.en: the morning market under the old stone arcades two centuries on — real fish on chilled, softly glowing counters, heaps of artichokes and lemons and little floating price tags of abstract light

scenes.ko: 카니발 — 사순절 앞 두 주의 가면 · 의상 축제
scenes.en: the Carnival of Venice — two weeks of elaborate costumes and masks in the squares and on the bridges before Lent

fantasy.en: the great arcaded square by the lagoon at carnival — revellers in gilded masks, silk, velvet and towering plumes parading between the arcades, confetti in the air and gondolas waiting at the quay

steampunk.en: the great arcaded square by the lagoon at carnival under strings of gas lamps — revellers in gilded masks, brass filigree, silk and plumes, confetti drifting and a brass band playing under the arcades

cyberpunk.en: the great arcaded square by the lagoon at carnival two centuries on — revellers in gilded masks and gowns of silk and soft light, confetti of glowing paper drifting and camera drones hovering overhead

scenes.ko: 프리톨레 — 카니발 철 빵집의 둥근 튀김 과자
scenes.en: buying frìtole, the round fried carnival doughnuts with raisins and pine nuts, at a pastry shop in carnival season

fantasy.en: a little pastry shop on a canal-side lane, its window piled with trays of golden carnival fritters dusted with sugar and a lantern glowing over the counter

steampunk.en: a little pastry shop on a canal-side lane in warm gaslight, its window piled with trays of golden carnival fritters dusted with sugar and a brass coffee machine hissing on the counter

cyberpunk.en: a little old pastry shop on a canal-side lane kept as it was, trays of golden carnival fritters dusted with sugar behind a softly glowing glass counter

scenes.ko: 무라노 — 유리섬 화로 공방에서 유리 부는 것 구경
scenes.en: a trip to Murano, the glass island, watching a glassblower at the furnace and choosing a piece of coloured glass

fantasy.en: a glass-furnace workshop on the glass island, the furnace mouth glowing gold, a glassmaker turning a bright gather of molten glass on a long pipe and shelves of goblets glittering in every colour

steampunk.en: a glass-furnace workshop on the glass island, the furnace mouth glowing amber under a tall brass chimney, a glassmaker turning molten glass on a brass pipe and shelves of goblets and chandelier arms glittering

cyberpunk.en: an old glass-furnace workshop on the glass island two centuries on, the same furnace glowing amber, a glassmaker turning molten glass on a long pipe and shelves of coloured glass lit softly from below

scenes.ko: 부라노 — 레이스와 알록달록한 집들의 섬 나들이
scenes.en: a day out on Burano, the lagoon island known for its lace and its small brightly painted houses along little canals

fantasy.en: a little canal on the lace island lined with small houses painted cherry, cobalt, lemon and lime, washing strung between windows, lace drying on a sill and boats moored below

steampunk.en: a little canal on the lace island lined with small houses painted cherry, cobalt, lemon and lime, washing strung between windows, a brass street lamp and boats moored below

cyberpunk.en: a little canal on the lace island kept as it was, small houses painted cherry, cobalt, lemon and lime, washing strung between windows and a little camera drone hovering over the boats

scenes.ko: 리도 — 석호 바깥 긴 모래섬의 바닷가
scenes.en: a summer day at the Lido, the long sandy barrier island between the lagoon and the Adriatic

fantasy.en: a long golden beach on the sandy barrier island facing the open sea, rows of striped canvas cabanas and the towers of the lagoon city faint on the horizon behind

steampunk.en: a long golden beach on the sandy barrier island, rows of striped bathing cabanas and canvas parasols, a little brass-funnelled steamer bringing bathers across the lagoon

cyberpunk.en: a long golden beach on the sandy barrier island two centuries on, striped smart-fabric cabanas, the great sea gates resting low in the water beyond

scenes.ko: 아쿠아 알타 — 물이 찬 광장 · 부두를 건너는 날
scenes.en: getting about the city on a day of acqua alta, the exceptional tides from autumn to spring that flood the low squares and quays

fantasy.en: a little square flooded a hand deep by the high tide, the arcades and lace-arched windows mirrored in the still water and people crossing carefully in tall boots

steampunk.en: a little square flooded a hand deep by the high tide, gas lamps and arcades mirrored in the water, a brass tide gauge on the wall and people crossing carefully in tall boots

cyberpunk.en: a little square flooded a hand deep by the high tide two centuries on, the old arcades mirrored in the water and soft lines of light glowing under it to show the dry way

scenes.ko: 비엔날레 — 두 해마다 열리는 국제 미술 전시
scenes.en: visiting the Venice Biennale, the international art exhibition held every two years, wandering its pavilions in Castello

fantasy.en: a bright pavilion hall in the exhibition gardens, great strange works of painted silk and carved stone set out on a pale floor and tall doors open onto green gardens

steampunk.en: a bright pavilion hall in the exhibition gardens under a glass-and-iron roof, great strange works of brass, glass and canvas set out on a pale floor

cyberpunk.en: a bright pavilion hall in the exhibition gardens two centuries on, great strange works of light and living material set out on a pale floor

scenes.ko: 오페라 극장 — 금빛 객석의 밤 공연
scenes.en: a night at La Fenice, the city's historic opera house, rebuilt more than once after fire

fantasy.en: the gilded opera house of the floating capital at night — a grand staircase of pale marble, tiers of gold-and-ivory boxes and a great chandelier blazing overhead

steampunk.en: the gilded opera house at night in warm gaslight — a grand staircase of pale marble, tiers of gold-and-ivory boxes and a great glass chandelier blazing overhead

cyberpunk.en: the gilded opera house two centuries on, kept exactly as it was — a grand staircase of pale marble, tiers of gold-and-ivory boxes and a great chandelier blazing overhead

scenes.ko: 구시가 광장 — 천문시계 정시를 기다리는 사람들 사이
scenes.en: waiting among the crowd in Old Town Square for the hour to strike on the medieval astronomical clock of the Old Town Hall, pastel house fronts all around

fantasy.en: the old town square of the capital ringed by pastel gabled house fronts and arcades, a crowd gathered under the Gothic town-hall tower to watch the great astronomical clock of gold and deep blue strike the hour, lanterns on the arcades

steampunk.en: the old town square in warm gaslight, pastel gables and arcades all around, a crowd gathered under the Gothic town-hall tower as the great astronomical clock with its blue-and-gold dial and turning zodiac ring strikes the hour

cyberpunk.en: the old town square kept exactly as it stands under a transparent canopy two centuries on, pastel gables lit from within and a crowd waiting under the Gothic town-hall tower as the old astronomical clock strikes the hour

scenes.ko: 새벽 카를교 — 아직 조용한 돌다리 산책
scenes.en: an early-morning walk across Charles Bridge before the crowds, the medieval stone bridge quiet in the mist, its Gothic bridge towers at either end and the castle above the river

fantasy.en: the old stone bridge of sixteen arches at dawn, mist rising off the green river, lanterns still glowing on the parapets between dark Gothic gate towers and the castle-palace pale on the ridge above

steampunk.en: the old stone bridge at dawn, mist on the river, gas lamps along the parapets just going out, a paddle steamer moored below and the long castle-palace on the ridge catching the first light

cyberpunk.en: the old stone bridge at dawn two centuries on, kept exactly as it stands, mist on the river, slender bridges of light arcing beside it and the castle on the ridge catching the first light

scenes.ko: 동네 맥주집 — 거품 두껍게 올린 황금빛 필스너 한 잔
scenes.en: an evening in a Prague beer hall over a pale golden pilsner-type lager with a thick foam head, long wooden tables and a busy bar

fantasy.en: a vaulted old tavern of the capital, long scrubbed-oak tables under iron lanterns, a barkeep drawing golden lager from a wooden cask into tall mugs with thick foam heads

steampunk.en: a vaulted beer hall in warm gaslight, long wooden tables, polished brass taps at the bar pouring golden lager into dimpled glass mugs with thick foam heads

cyberpunk.en: a vaulted beer hall two centuries on, its old stone vaults kept as they are, long tables of real oak with softly glowing edges, golden lager with a thick foam head poured from sleek taps

scenes.ko: 점심 식당 — 크네들리키(빵 경단)를 곁들인 스비치코바
scenes.en: lunch in a Czech restaurant — marinated beef in a creamy vegetable sauce with sliced bread dumplings, a spoon of cranberries and a dollop of cream

fantasy.en: a cosy timbered inn of the capital at noon, a window table laid with an embroidered cloth, a plate of marinated beef in golden cream sauce with sliced bread dumplings

steampunk.en: a cosy lunch restaurant with lace curtains and polished wood, a window table set with china, a plate of marinated beef in golden cream sauce with sliced bread dumplings

cyberpunk.en: a cosy lunch restaurant two centuries on, warm wood and a softly glowing table, a plate of marinated beef in golden cream sauce with sliced bread dumplings

scenes.ko: 트램 — 강변을 따라 덜컹이며 가는 빨간 트램
scenes.en: riding a Prague tram along the river embankment, the bridges and the castle sliding past the windows

fantasy.en: a little open horse-drawn tram-carriage of the capital rolling along the river embankment, wooden benches and lantern hooks, the bridges and the castle-palace sliding past

steampunk.en: a red-and-cream brass-trimmed tram rolling along the river embankment, wooden bench seats and brass grab poles, the bridges and the castle-palace sliding past the windows

cyberpunk.en: a sleek quiet tram two centuries on gliding along the river embankment, softly glowing seats and wide clear windows, the old bridges and the castle sliding past

scenes.ko: 페트린 언덕 — 푸니쿨라 타고 장미 정원 · 철골 탑으로
